title: Genome-Wide Identification and Characterization of GRAS Transcription Factor Family in Cultivated Hybrid Sugarcane ZZ1 (Saccharum officinarum) and Their Role in Development and Stress.
authors: Wen, Hao; Wang, Lidan; Gong, Yuqing; Zhang, Yu; Zhao, Tingting; Feng, Cuilian; Wang, Jungang; Lin, Jishan
one_liner_zh: 该文对甘蔗GRAS转录因子家族进行全基因组鉴定与结构分析，虽涉及TF和AlphaFold3结构预测，但缺乏蛋白-DNA互作结合位点预测或互作机制建模，仅属边缘相关。
abstract: GRAS gene family plays multifunctional roles in plant growth, development, and resistance to various biotic and abiotic stresses, belonging to the plant-specific transcription factor (TF) family. In this study, a genome-wide survey and systematic analysis of the GRAS family in cultivated hybrid sugarcane ZZ1 (Saccharum officinarum) with economic and industrial importance was carried out. We identified 747 GRAS genes with complete structural domains and classified these into 11 subfamilies by phylogenetic analyses, exhibiting a diverse range of molecular weight and isoelectric points, thereby indicating a broad structural and functional spectrum. Analysis of Protein motif and gene structure revealed a conserved yet variable arrangement of motifs within the GRAS TFs, suggesting its potential for diverse functional roles. Furthermore, the identification of numerous cis-regulatory elements by GRAS TFs promoter sequence analysis, implying their complex regulation in response to environmental and physiological signals. Tertiary structure predictions analyses using AlphaFold3 highlighted the structural flexibility and conservation within the GRAS family, with disordered regions potentially contributing to their functional versatility. Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) provided insights into the potential roles of ShGRAS21A in sugarcane's response to smut infection. This comprehensive investigation of the GRAS family in ZZ1 not only uncovers their structural diversity but also sheds light on their potential regulatory roles in plant growth, development, and stress response. The findings contribute to a deeper understanding of GRAS TFs functions and lay the groundwork for future studies on their role in sugarcane improvement and disease resistance.
abstract_zh: GRAS基因家族属于植物特异性转录因子（transcription factor, TF）家族，在植物生长、发育以及对多种生物和非生物胁迫的抗性中发挥多功能作用。本研究对具有经济和工业重要性的栽培杂交甘蔗ZZ1（Saccharum officinarum）中的GRAS家族进行了全基因组调查和系统分析。我们鉴定了747个具有完整结构域的GRAS基因，并通过系统发育分析将其分为11个亚家族，这些基因表现出多样的分子量和等电点，从而指示了广泛的结构和功能谱。蛋白质基序和基因结构分析揭示了GRAS转录因子内基序的保守但可变的排列，表明其具有多种功能角色的潜力。此外，通过GRAS转录因子启动子序列分析鉴定了大量顺式调控元件，暗示其在响应环境和生理信号中的复杂调控。使用AlphaFold3进行的三级结构预测分析强调了GRAS家族内的结构灵活性和保守性，其中无序区域可能有助于其功能多样性。加权基因共表达网络分析（Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis, WGCNA）提供了对ShGRAS21A在甘蔗响应黑穗病感染中潜在作用的见解。这项对ZZ1中GRAS家族的全面研究不仅揭示了其结构多样性，还阐明了其在植物生长、发育和胁迫响应中的潜在调控作用。这些发现有助于更深入地理解GRAS转录因子的功能，并为未来研究其在甘蔗改良和抗病性中的作用奠定了基础。
